topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: The path we once walked, now overgrown. I spoke of days we forged with laughter like sunlight through leaves, yet their eyes held shadows, the ground beneath our feet unfamiliar. They speak of new friends, their words a stream that no longer passes by where I stand. The air is dense, the colors seem to fade, and the silence that follows their words is a forest I cannot navigate. I hold onto the edges of what was, fingers brushing against the rough bark of memories, hoping the shape of the past can guide me through this uncharted land.
